name: 书剑飘零官方教学版
group_note: ES II lineage (adm/obj/master.lpc, 'original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator'), 飞白工作室's 书剑飘零 teaching edition. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60-class master.lpc report_error() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash (a THIRD call site of this pattern beyond the usual log_error()/standard_trace() pair -- report_error() is its own separate function here), guarded with find_object(CHANNEL_D). (2) adm/daemons/whod.lpc used an undefined REMOTE_DIR constant, breaking its (preloaded) compile -- added #define REMOTE_DIR "/data/remote/" to globals.h (no on-disk directory existed to infer the value from; get_dir() on a missing directory just returns empty, so this is safe even though the directory itself was never created). (3) §7.41-class corrupted shipped save data: adm/daemons/emoted.lpc's create() called an unguarded restore() on its own corrupted emoted.o, throwing uncaught during preload; guarded with catch(restore()) plus an explicit emote=([]) fallback. Investigated at length and ruled out as NOT a bug: repeated '你发现事情不大对了' messages seen during registration are this mudlib's own (noisy but intentional) design -- master.lpc's log_error() tells whichever player happens to be connected about EVERY compile warning encountered while their character's inherited feature files (alias/damage/more/move/skill/troop) compile for the first time; confirmed by temporarily making error_handler always show full detail, which revealed every instance was a harmless 'Unused local variable' warning. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib does NOT have the securd/securityd split seen in sj -- securityd.lpc is the genuine, sole security daemon here). Verified: full registration (id->confirm->name->password->confirm->email->gender->birth-origin choice) -> look/score/quit all clean, permission displays (admin) correctly, update succeeds. LPC formatter run across all 2310 files; reverted 1 file with confirmed corruption (a stray-quote-loss class, not the usual CJK-respacing shape but caught by the same despaced-matches-old-file scan) across 17 formatter-touched CJK-spacing files; no map.lpc ASCII-art files present in this lib. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
